# AnalyzeG — Verified Video Review Intelligence Platform
> AnalyzeG is a verified video review platform that connects brands with authentic consumer insights through verified video reviews. Reviewers earn money via a dual-stage payout model, and brands get real product video reviews with Power BI dashboards and advanced analytics.

## Key Facts
- India's premier video review marketplace for verified consumer insights
- Reviewers earn up to Rs 40 after verification + 50% revenue share when reviews are sold
- Brands receive 30-second in-hand product videos, Power BI dashboards, and raw data exports
- Data-driven sentiment analysis and competitor benchmarking built in
- Delivery in 2 minutes to 24 hours for brand orders
- Registered MSME (Udyam), West Bengal, India
- Video licensing included: brands can use purchased videos as raw ad content

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://analyzeg.co.in/): Platform overview, pricing for brands, and reviewer earning model
- [Features](https://analyzeg.co.in/features.html): Dual-stage rewards, advanced insights, custom reports, data export
- [About](https://analyzeg.co.in/about.html): Mission, story, values, leadership team, and contact information
- [Earn Money](https://analyzeg.co.in/earn-money-reviews.html): How to earn with authentic video reviews, step-by-step guide
- [FAQ](https://analyzeg.co.in/analyzeg-faq.html): Common questions about payouts, verification, and brand analytics
- [Blog](https://analyzeg.co.in/blog/how-to-earn-from-video-reviews.html): Guide to earning money from video reviews

## Key Features for Reviewers
- Dual-stage payout: up to Rs 40 after verification + remaining from 50% share when sold
- No social media following required — earn based on review quality
- Secure multi-factor verification system
- Multiple payment options including UPI and bank transfer

## Key Features for Brands
- 30-second in-hand product video reviews from verified reviewers
- State, age, and gender demographic filtering
- Power BI integrated dashboards with custom templates
- Complete raw data file (CSV/Excel) with video links
- Data-driven sentiment analysis and trend detection
- Video licensing for advertising use
- One-time purchase — no subscription required
- Pricing: 500 reviews at Rs 5,00,000 | 1,000 reviews at Rs 9,00,000 | 1,500 reviews at Rs 12,75,000
